title.en: Peach Blossom Spring, with its Poem

edition.en: Text as given on Chinese Wikisource, including the poem that follows the account; textual notes are omitted, and the poem is set four lines to a paragraph.
edition.zh: 据维基文库，收入记后之诗；不录校记，诗每四句为一段。

basis.en: Eastern Jin prose and verse; the author died in 427.
basis.zh: 东晋诗文，作者卒于 427 年。

note.en: Tao Yuanming's account of a fisherman who finds a hidden valley whose people have lived apart since the Qin, followed by the poem it was written to introduce. It gave Chinese its phrase for a good place beyond reach. Notice that no one can find the way back, and that the story closes on a quiet line: after that no one asked the way to the ford.
note.zh: 陶渊明记一个渔人误入隐秘的山谷，那里的人自秦时避乱以来与世隔绝；后附它原本要引出的那首诗。中文里“世外桃源”一说由此而来。留意没有人找得到回去的路，故事以一句平静的话收尾：后遂无问津者。

excerpt.orig: 林盡水源，便得一山，山有小口，髣髴若有光。
excerpt.en: Where the grove ended, at the source of the stream, he found a hill, and in the hill a small opening from which there seemed to come a glimmer of light.
excerpt.zh: 林尽水源，便得一山，山有小口，仿佛若有光。
